During the [[Eternal Empire]]'s reign, the Commander of the [[Eternal Alliance|resistance movement]] on [[Odessen]], also known as [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], wondered into the wilderness of Odessen and encountered [[Satele Shan]] and the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Darth Marr]], who had the Outlander construct '''a weapon''' to defeat [[Arcann]] with the energy of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Chapter 12" />
